protocol.cache: warm; points already in memory; no disk I/O in timing
protocol.moments: Moments.from_points only: mean, monomials, 10x10 Gram matrix
protocol.from_moments: fit_patch only: classification, extent, inverse covariance, coefficients, MSE
protocol.excluded: point generation, disk I/O, segmentation, association, registration, map update
protocol.synthetic: 2m sphere or tilted plane, 2mm standard-deviation normal noise; float64 XYZ
protocol.note: Per-call latencies of the independent Python implementation, not author C++ timings. No nonlinear ML refinement.
